status: PG investigation completed; original published-release acceptance remains open

warmed_diagnostic.method: Same-process co-loaded versions with interleaved inputs, fixed repeats and 30 samples; diagnostic only, not the independent-worker acceptance gate.
warmed_diagnostic.interpretation: Matched full and dynamic states improve approximately 4-5 percent and status-preserving HX approximately 10 percent versus frozen source in this run. Scalar compressor/expander timings and executable programs are effectively unchanged. Published-release status/batch costs remain; do not claim the 10 percent gate is fixed.

hlo.counting: Static total instruction lines across all computation definitions, including ROOT, fusion bodies and both branches; not executed operation counts or timing estimates.

successful_arm_control.comparison: Shared-context C2 paired_models current versus final paired_final current; outer successful full HP 1024 branch plus transitive fusion bodies.
successful_arm_control.normalization: Remove metadata, omit computation headers, substitute recursively hashed called computations, then consistently alpha-rename local SSA values. Body types, layouts, operations, constants and operand relationships remain compared.

cold_public_call.scope: Whole first synchronized public HP 1024 call in a fresh process/cache; model construction and device startup excluded.
cold_public_call.interpretation: Primary frozen 203.661 ms to current 200.374 ms is a small overlapping observation, not a fixed cold budget. Current exceeds this run's 182.008 ms public allowance. Earlier Phase 13 had a 163.113 ms allowance from its own published baseline; no budget formula changed.

separate_cold_stage_diagnostics.scope: Different fresh workers from the primary public-call observations; never sum or relabel stage medians as that whole call.
separate_cold_stage_diagnostics.interpretation: Trace/lower 87.115 to 66.548 ms and compilation 137.871 to 113.109 ms support reduced staged work. First executable dispatch remains below 1 ms. These measurements do not establish whole-public-call acceptance.

status_output_attribution.interpretation: Scalar numerical-only current/PyPI ratios 1.016 and 1.094 contrast with actual-status 1.418 and 1.492; required status retention/checking and additional device leaves account for substantial cost in this experiment. Numerical-only HX still 1.485 relative to PyPI because policy/masking work survives. Packed-status results diagnose return layout; no public output/status change was implemented.
status_output_attribution.restriction: Projections, packing and broader-vs-matched dynamic parameter subsets remain explanatory diagnostics. Mandatory full-state and actual-status acceptance workloads are unchanged; legacy status is never fabricated.

correctness.focused_command: pytest tests/test_phase14_perfect_gas.py tests/test_phase7_perfect_gas.py tests/test_perfect_gas_hotpath.py tests/test_phase9_model_jvp.py -c tests/pytest.ini -q --tb=short
correctness.coverage: All 22 fields and independent HP equations; mixed/valid/all-failed cohorts; mask/clip/status/clipping; sizes 63/64/65/128/1024; failed gradients; full-field gamma/h_ref JVP/VJP; prior model/input/extreme-state oracles.
correctness.final_full_suite: Running independently under root; this record does not claim its result or completion of the final PyPI gate.

deferred_not_implemented.temperature_limit_simplification: DEFERRED. Removing algebraically redundant R/cv bounds needs floating-point and AD tie proof. Rounded gamma*R/(gamma-1) can move relative to R; minimum/maximum tie subgradients can change even with equal primals. Test float32/64, nextafter cp=1, gamma near 1 / large gamma,positive/zero/negative offsets, ceiling neighbors and input/model JVP/VJP before any future change. No representability bound or proof simplification was implemented.

implemented_changes.name: shared dynamic heat-capacity context
implemented_changes.scope: Derive cp/cv once in the native evaluator and reuse cp through resolution, PT assembly, entropy and the cp field. No static cache or frozen numerical model parameter.
implemented_changes.attribution: Small full-state graph reduction; no independently established scalar consumer speedup.

implemented_changes.name: direct masking in known-failed large-batch arm
implemented_changes.scope: The outer all-success condition already proves failure in its false arm; mask every property and clipping flag directly, then use trusted assembly instead of staging another all-success conditional.
implemented_changes.unchanged: Threshold 64, scalar/small/raise paths, all 22 PG fields, masks, status precedence, clipping and failure-safe input/model AD.

implementation_decision: Retained local candidate after correctness review; formal performance acceptance remains open.
